betterquesting:10.desc:8:
Fast-forward a red giant into a §bneutron star§r, and stop it going supernova.

§e§lBEFORE§r
- the T3 milestones;
- the §bGalactic Upgrade Core§r in escrow;
- the §bspiral arms§r (stack 4: 5,325 Galactic Shell Plating);
- compression 4;
- Arcturus lit and Stable;
- §b5,000 L HSM§r buffered.
Swap in §bStar Chart: Neutron Star§r.

§e§l1 FAST-FORWARD§r (about 16 min). Dose §bTachyon Rich Temporal Fluid§r into the Field sockets, up to 100 L/s. The core climbs from 0.50 to §b1.44 M☉§r, which takes 94,000 L. The envelope swells as it goes, and your T3 rig must hold the field through it.

§e§l2 BOUNCE§r The HSM becomes the neutron seed, and the shock hits P and Θ for §b+150§r.
- Every §b1,000 L of molten SpaceTime§r in the buffers at that moment cancels 1 point, up to 90,000 L.
- Any gauge above +100 means §c§lSUPERNOVA§r: Arcturus, the Time fluid, the HSM and the SpaceTime are lost. The core stays in escrow.

§e§l3 SETTLE§r Hold Stable for 60 seconds within 180. T4 is then yours.

§e§lTHE NEUTRON STAR§r
- It has no fusion, so it needs no H or He. §b144 L molten SpaceTime§r a cycle holds it.
- Set the §bHSM feed§r in the GUI (0-1.5 L/s, default 0.694). §bWhite Dwarf Matter = 3.6864 L per L of HSM fed.§r
- Every 0.1 L/s of feed pushes P, Θ and the spin §bΩ§r up. Ω runs away by itself, and §bglitches§r kick it +20 without warning.
- New trims: Space (P −2), SpaceTime (P +2), Molten Purified Tengam 36 L (Ω −4).
- If it breaches, it collapses into a black hole. Relight Arcturus and rerun the collapse; no core is needed the second time.

[note]The Deep Dark planet runs at T4.[/note]

§a§lDONE WHEN§r you hold the core and the chart (HOLD → CLAIM → INSTALL: claim before the core goes into escrow).
